project.title: AI RPG Engine: Aetheria
project.subtitle: Fantasy RPG and Realm Simulation Engine featuring 4-Level RAG Architecture, Multi-LLM Providers, and Relational Persistence.
project.screenshot_alt: AI RPG Game user interface screenshot

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.p1: The AI RPG Engine is a comprehensive roleplaying and procedural realm simulation system. Its primary goal is solving one of the major bottlenecks in LLM-driven gaming: context decay, mathematical hallucinations, and long-term narrative inconsistency.
overview.p2: Combining FastAPI on the backend with a decoupled Python engine, the system features transactional persistence in SQLite3 (WAL), a custom vector engine for Episodic RAG, and a rich SPA frontend crafted with Vanilla JavaScript and Glassmorphism CSS.

pillars.title: Architectural Pillars & Engineering
pillars.p1_desc: To support long-running campaigns with hundreds of turns without degrading the context window, memory is structured into four complementary layers:
pillars.m1: 1. Immediate Window: Short-term conversational context of recent player actions and dialogue.
pillars.m2: 2. Structured World State (SQLite WAL): Strict relational persistence of resources, population, treasury, military units, taxes, and periodic events with ACID integrity.
pillars.m3: 3. Episodic Vector Memory (RAG): Semantic embeddings with importance scoring (0.0 to 1.0) and cosine similarity retrieval for critical historical events.
pillars.m4: 4. Hierarchical Chronicle Compression: Periodic chapter synthesis that condenses past turns into concise summaries, drastically reducing token consumption.
pillars.p2_desc: Architecture powered by LLMFactory and abstraction layers enabling automatic fallback upon rate-limits or outages across Google Gemini (2.5 Flash), xAI Grok-2, OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, and Local Ollama, guaranteeing structured JSON output with Pydantic validation.
pillars.p3_desc: Built strictly under Clean Architecture and SOLID principles. Pure domain logic decoupled from web frameworks, backed by a comprehensive Pytest suite, and enriched with structured execution logs for AI reasoning tracking.
pillars.p4_desc: Modern real-time HUD with kingdom resource meters, public morale tracking, territorial graph maps, narrative chronicle logs, and dynamic leader portraits for multiple factions.

highlights.title: Implementation Highlights
highlights.h1_desc: Rigorous mathematical formulas for revenue, public happiness, and military upkeep calculated per turn in the StateManager.
highlights.h2_desc: Living documentation with D2 diagrams and a rigorous specification lifecycle (Requirements -> Design -> Tasks -> Tests).
highlights.h3_desc: Centralized configuration management and clean structured logs ensuring zero exposure of API keys or credentials.

project_rungun.badge: UFPR Academic Project & C Systems Engineering
project_rungun.title: Run & Gun: 2D Retro Arcade Platformer
project_rungun.subtitle: 2D Action Platformer and Shooter built in C (C99) and Allegro 5, featuring a Finite State Machine (FSM), Custom Physics, Ballistics Engine, and Binary Persistence.
project_rungun.screenshot_alt: Run and Gun arcade game gameplay screenshot

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.p1: Developed as a major hands-on project for the Programming 2 course at UFPR (B.Sc. in Computer Science), Run & Gun is an arcade side-scrolling shooter inspired by 90s retro action classics.
overview.p2: Engineered from scratch without third-party game engines to master low-level software architecture, memory lifecycle, and hardware abstractions. Written in pure C (C99) using the Allegro 5 multimedia library, the system implements an AABB collision physics engine, a finite state machine for screen and menu transitions, a dynamic projectile pooling system, and structured on-disk data persistence.

pillars.title: Technical Pillars & Software Architecture
pillars.p1_desc: Clean decoupled state machine governing all game execution modes:
pillars.m1: 1. Menu & Shop: Dynamic character roster selection and permanent upgrade purchasing using collected coins.
pillars.m2: 2. Main Gameplay Loop: Smooth 60 FPS execution with precise event synchronization and timer management.
pillars.m3: 3. Pause & Free Mode: Instant state switching while retaining complete entity memory and coordinates.
pillars.m4: 4. Game Over & Level Complete: Robust transitions with scoring computation and progression persistence.
pillars.p2_desc: Proprietary physics engine computing gravity, platform Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) collision, inertial jumping, and dynamic camera scrolling. Ballistics system with projectile structs, fire rates, class-specific damage scaling, and effective ranges.
pillars.p3_title: Strict Manual Memory Management in C
pillars.p3_desc: Manual heap allocation and deallocation in C. Deterministic lifecycle for spritesheets, bitmaps, audio samples, and entity pools, ensuring zero memory leaks verified via profiling tools.
pillars.p4_desc: Structured binary and text serialization module (Save/Load with save.dat) saving collected gold, highscores, and character unlocks across sessions.

highlights.title: Engineering Highlights & Gameplay
highlights.h1_desc: Samurai (sword slash & agility), Gangster, Pedro, Raider, Sniper (long-range high damage), and Soldier, each with custom spritesheets, hitboxes, and weapon metrics.
highlights.h2_desc: Patrolling and ranged enemies like Skeleton Archer and Minotaur, plus 3 Bosses (Carnivora, Bruto, Page) with multi-phase attack patterns and hit reactions.
highlights.h3_desc: Real-time sound effects and soundtrack mixer using Allegro Audio, paired with gamepad and mapped keyboard support.

project_nutri.badge: Early Academic Project (1st Semester) & CS50 Final Project
project_nutri.title: Nutri Assistente: Nutritional Calculations & Patient Tracking Platform
project_nutri.subtitle: First fullstack web project developed during the 1st semester of university (CS50 Final Project) with Laravel, Blade, metabolic formulas, and API integrations.

overview.title: Project Overview & Learning Context
overview.p1: Nutri Assistente was the very first complete fullstack web project developed during the 1st semester of Computer Science, also serving as the final project for Harvard's CS50. The system was designed to address a real need presented by a nutritionist who needed an accessible tool to calculate metabolic rates, energy expenditure, BMI, and track patient physical evolution.
overview.p2: As an early beginner project, the codebase reflects the starting stages of learning: it features architectural simplifications, beginner technical debt, and centralized routing, serving as an authentic historical milestone in engineering growth. It provided crucial hands-on foundation in PHP/Laravel, relational modeling with Eloquent ORM, server-side templating with Blade, and third-party integrations with ZeroBounce and Google Gemini.

pillars.title: Functional Pillars & Engineering Milestone
pillars.p1_desc: Direct mathematical implementation of standard clinical nutrition formulas and reference tables:
pillars.m1: 1. BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate): Harris-Benedict equations tailored by gender, age group, weight, and height.
pillars.m2: 2. TEE (Total Energy Expenditure): Physical activity factors (AF) and DRI/IOM methodology across life stages.
pillars.m3: 3. BMI Classification: Clinical thresholds for children, adults, and elderly populations.
pillars.m4: 4. Anthropometric Timeline: Historical logging of weigh-ins and body measurements to track patient progress.
pillars.p2_desc: Custom authentication workflow using unique alphanumeric codes generated per nutritionist, allowing practitioners to manage dedicated patients or share their code for client self-registration.
pillars.p3_desc: Early hands-on exploration of external services: real-time email deliverability checks via ZeroBounce API and anamnesis PDF parsing (Smalot PDF Parser) sending extracted text to Google Gemini API for preliminary suggestions.
pillars.p4_desc: Represents the starting point of the software engineering journey: shipping a working product that solves user problems, whose technical trade-offs motivated deep mastery of Clean Architecture, TDD, and SOLID principles.

highlights.title: Highlights & Learned Lessons
highlights.h1_desc: Built and deployed during the very first months of college studies, integrating relational databases, input validation, and business logic.
highlights.h2_desc: Crafted from practical requirements gathered directly with a working nutritionist to streamline consultation calculations.
highlights.h3_desc: A simple legacy project with acknowledged beginner imperfections, transparently documented to showcase engineering progression and maturity over time.

project_lunar_chat.title: Lunar Chat: Real-Time Multi-Room Web Messaging
project_lunar_chat.subtitle: Real-Time Chat & Messaging System powered by Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Public/Private Room Isolation, and Event-Driven Architecture.

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.p1: Lunar Chat 🌙 is a bidirectional real-time messaging and chat platform designed to thoroughly explore the WebSockets protocol, concurrency, and multi-client connection management using Socket.IO and Express.
overview.p2: Built upon an event-driven architecture in Node.js, the system features dynamic creation of public and private rooms with unique 10-digit codes, in-memory presence synchronization with atomic user counters, and a reactive SPA interface built with Vanilla JavaScript and Dark Mode CSS.

pillars.title: Architectural Pillars & Real-Time Engineering
pillars.p1_desc: Low-latency persistent transport engineering with protocol negotiation:
pillars.m1: 1. Handshake & Upgrade: Seamless connection startup via HTTP Long-Polling with transparent upgrade to native WebSockets.
pillars.m2: 2. Event-Driven Pub/Sub: Decoupled message broadcasting (roomMessage, publicRoomsUpdate, system) eliminating HTTP polling overhead.
pillars.m3: 3. Selective Broadcasting: Pinpoint message distribution using socket.to(room).emit to strictly isolate communication within active room participants.
pillars.m4: 4. Delta Room Synchronization: Efficient broadcasting of updated public room lists triggered only upon actual state mutations.
pillars.p2_desc: Strict channel partitioning using Socket.IO Room Adapters and in-memory Maps, preventing data leakage between conversations and generating secure random codes for private rooms.
pillars.p3_desc: Autonomous backend cleanup detecting abrupt socket disconnections, dynamically adjusting live member counts, and purging empty rooms from memory without polling overhead.
pillars.p4_desc: Client structured as a lightweight DOM finite-state machine (Setup, Lobby, Creation, and Chat screens), providing sub-second load times, dynamic auto-scrolling, and responsive user feedback.

highlights.title: Engineering Highlights & Features
highlights.h1_desc: Procedural cosmic room name generation (e.g. Cosmic Nebula, Starry Citadel) paired with unique numeric room codes for instant invite sharing.
highlights.h2_desc: Dedicated channel for room lifecycle events (user join, leave, connection drops) cleanly rendered into the message stream.
highlights.h3_desc: Constructed purely with Vanilla JavaScript, manipulating DOM nodes with direct high-performance operations without frontend framework bloat.
